en.text: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子乌西雅接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。（

zhTraditional.text: 猶大眾民立亞瑪謝的兒子烏西雅接續他父作王，那時他年十六歲。（

en.text: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，乌西雅收回以禄仍归犹大，又重新修理。）

zhTraditional.text: 亞瑪謝與他列祖同睡之後，烏西雅收回以祿仍歸猶大，又重新修理。）

en.text: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅登基的時候年十六歲，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母親名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。

en.text: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亚玛谢一切所行的；

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅行耶和華眼中看為正的事，效法他父亞瑪謝一切所行的；

en.text: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper.

zhSimplified.text: 通晓 神默示，撒迦利亚在世的时候，乌西雅定意寻求 神；他寻求耶和华， 神就使他亨通。

zhTraditional.text: 通曉上帝默示，撒迦利亞在世的時候，烏西雅定意尋求上帝；他尋求耶和華，上帝就使他亨通。

en.text: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

zhSimplified.text: 他出去攻击非利士人，拆毁了迦特城、雅比尼城，和亚实突城；在非利士人中，在亚实突境内，又建筑了些城。

zhTraditional.text: 他出去攻擊非利士人，拆毀了迦特城、雅比尼城，和亞實突城；在非利士人中，在亞實突境內，又建築了些城。

en.text: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

zhSimplified.text: 神帮助他攻击非利士人和住在姑珥·巴力的阿拉伯人，并米乌尼人。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝幫助他攻擊非利士人和住在姑珥‧巴力的阿拉伯人，並米烏尼人。

en.text: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人给乌西雅进贡。他的名声传到埃及，因他甚是强盛。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人給烏西雅進貢。他的名聲傳到埃及，因他甚是強盛。

en.text: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门和谷门，并城墙转弯之处，建筑城楼，且甚坚固；

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅在耶路撒冷的角門和谷門，並城牆轉彎之處，建築城樓，且甚堅固；

en.text: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

zhSimplified.text: 又在旷野与高原和平原，建筑望楼，挖了许多井，因他的牲畜甚多；又在山地和佳美之地，有农夫和修理葡萄园的人，因为他喜悦农事。

zhTraditional.text: 又在曠野與高原和平原，建築望樓，挖了許多井，因他的牲畜甚多；又在山地和佳美之地，有農夫和修理葡萄園的人，因為他喜悅農事。

en.text: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅又有军兵，照书记耶利和官长玛西雅所数点的，在王的一个将军哈拿尼雅手下，分队出战。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅又有軍兵，照書記耶利和官長瑪西雅所數點的，在王的一個將軍哈拿尼雅手下，分隊出戰。

en.text: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 族长、大能勇士的总数共有二千六百人，

zhTraditional.text: 族長、大能勇士的總數共有二千六百人，

en.text: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

zhSimplified.text: 他们手下的军兵共有三十万七千五百人，都有大能，善于争战，帮助王攻击仇敌。

zhTraditional.text: 他們手下的軍兵共有三十萬七千五百人，都有大能，善於爭戰，幫助王攻擊仇敵。

en.text: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅为全军预备盾牌、枪、盔、甲、弓，和甩石的机弦，

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅為全軍預備盾牌、槍、盔、甲、弓，和甩石的機弦，

en.text: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

zhSimplified.text: 又在耶路撒冷使巧匠做机器，安在城楼和角楼上，用以射箭发石。乌西雅的名声传到远方；因为他得了非常的帮助，甚是强盛。

zhTraditional.text: 又在耶路撒冷使巧匠做機器，安在城樓和角樓上，用以射箭發石。烏西雅的名聲傳到遠方；因為他得了非常的幫助，甚是強盛。

en.text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against the LORD his God, for he went into the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

zhSimplified.text: 他既强盛，就心高气傲，以致行事邪僻，干犯耶和华—他的 神，进耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。

zhTraditional.text: 他既強盛，就心高氣傲，以致行事邪僻，干犯耶和華－他的上帝，進耶和華的殿，要在香壇上燒香。

en.text: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, who were valiant men.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司亚撒利雅率领耶和华勇敢的祭司八十人，跟随他进去。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司亞撒利雅率領耶和華勇敢的祭司八十人，跟隨他進去。

en.text: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from the LORD God.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们就阻挡乌西雅王，对他说：「乌西雅啊，给耶和华烧香不是你的事，乃是亚伦子孙承接圣职祭司的事。你出圣殿吧！因为你犯了罪。你行这事，耶和华 神必不使你得荣耀。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們就阻擋烏西雅王，對他說：「烏西雅啊，給耶和華燒香不是你的事，乃是亞倫子孫承接聖職祭司的事。你出聖殿吧！因為你犯了罪。你行這事，耶和華上帝必不使你得榮耀。」

en.text: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in the LORD’s house, beside the altar of incense.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅就发怒，手拿香炉要烧香。他向祭司发怒的时候，在耶和华殿中香坛旁众祭司面前，额上忽然发出大麻风。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅就發怒，手拿香爐要燒香。他向祭司發怒的時候，在耶和華殿中香壇旁眾祭司面前，額上忽然發出大痲瘋。

en.text: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because the LORD had struck him.

zhSimplified.text: 大祭司亚撒利雅和众祭司观看，见他额上发出大麻风，就催他出殿；他自己也急速出去，因为耶和华降灾与他。

zhTraditional.text: 大祭司亞撒利雅和眾祭司觀看，見他額上發出大痲瘋，就催他出殿；他自己也急速出去，因為耶和華降災與他。

en.text: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the LORD’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅王长大麻风直到死日，因此住在别的宫里，与耶和华的殿隔绝。他儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅王長大痲瘋直到死日，因此住在別的宮裏，與耶和華的殿隔絕。他兒子約坦管理家事，治理國民。

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅其余的事，自始至终都是亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚所记的。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅其餘的事，自始至終都是亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞所記的。

en.text: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅与他列祖同睡，葬在王陵的田间他列祖的坟地里；因为人说，他是长大麻风的。他儿子约坦接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅與他列祖同睡，葬在王陵的田間他列祖的墳地裏；因為人說，他是長大痲瘋的。他兒子約坦接續他作王。
